title: Delete Google Calendar events with AI after a precise check
h1: remove the right google calendar event
description: Ask a bot to delete a specific Google Calendar event after checking its calendar and date. Handle recurring instances and cancellation notices deliberately.
keyword: google calendar delete event with ai
answer: deleting a google calendar event needs more than its title: the bot must identify the calendar and the exact event, especially when it repeats. it can remove that event once you have checked the match. this is a write rather than a send in dusk bot, so cancellation must have an explicit ask-first instruction if you want review.
what:
give the bot a meeting reference or let find event locate it first. for a repeating meeting, say which date; deleting the series would remove every one.

deleting can email guests a cancellation, and that doesn't go through your sending setting. tell the bot whether guests should be told. the connected account also needs deletion permission on that calendar.
uses: cancel a training session that the facilitator has explicitly withdrawn
remove one dated occurrence during an office closure without selecting the whole series
clear an abandoned personal planning block after checking the exact calendar

routine.message: every monday at 4, find next week's events titled "temporary hold: wrenstone visit" on my work calendar. show each date and whether it belongs to a recurring series, then ask me which exact events to delete and who should receive cancellation updates. remove only the events i confirm and report the outcome here. never delete a whole series or treat a failed lookup as a successful cancellation.
routine.needs: google calendar connected, with read and write access and permission to delete the selected events
routine.output:
wrenstone visit holds
friday 10:00: one standalone event found.
please confirm deletion and your notification choice.

steps: select the calendar account in **Connected apps** and give the bot **read and write** only when cancellations are needed.
ask it to read back the event title, calendar, date and series status before the first deletion.
put your confirmation requirement into the routine itself; **Ask every time** under sending does not gate this action.
review its result and **Pause** the cleanup routine as soon as the temporary holds are resolved.
watch: if google says the event wasn't found, it may be on another calendar; the bot shouldn't report it as cancelled.
a subscribed calendar may be readable but refuse deletion because the account lacks permission.
choosing the whole repeating series instead of one date cancels more meetings than you intended.

faq.q: will dusk ask before cancelling a meeting?
faq.a: not through the sending control. this action is a calendar change, so ask for a confirmation step in your message before granting writes.

faq.q: can it delete only next week's occurrence?
faq.a: yes. have the bot show the exact date and delete only that meeting, leaving the rest of the series alone.
